text: Otsukimi Venue: Crater Zone
Kaguya
Pelulu
Kaguya
Voice
[ff6464]Otsukimi Event has ended.[ffffff]
Well, we've defeated those 2 shady creatures,\nany sweet deal for us...?
...Oh, shooooot!!\nMore shady creatures are cominggg!!
It's all right...They're my servants...
It's all right...? No way! No, it's not all right!
...Oh, dear. What makes you uncomfortable?
Hm? Well...if you ask me...that empty look in\ntheir eyes is creepy.
In that case...what about this?
I-it's even worse because they might turn around\nsuddenly...
...You're so hard to please.\nI can't hear you very well from there.\nPlease come over here...
Shoooot?!
Anything wrong...?
N-nothing.\nJ-just make them like before again.
...Fine, I will.
Y-you said they're your servants...\nW-what do you mean? Are you the boss here?
...Sorry for the late introduction.\nMy name is Kaguya.
I'm the ruler of this moon and I'm mainly in\ncharge of this mansion.
Really? But no matter how I look at you...
Shooot?!
It's a complicated story...\nYou guys may leave.
I should have done this from the start...
W-woww...you're really their boss...
...Is there anything that makes you doubt me?
No, no, wait, you don't look alike at all!\nYour ears aren't long, and you don't have a tail.\nYou and those creatures have nothing in common...
I do have a tail...
Oh, it's like that. Let me touch it...
No way...\nIf my tail is touched, t-the world will...
What? T-the world will?!
...Ahem...\nAnyway, now you believe I'm their master, right?
Umm...I'm not very sure about that...
Oh, right! What's that crab-like monster?!\nWe and your servants ran here because we were\nbeing chased by that thing.
...Oh, that's the giant crab that has lived here\nsince a long time ago. It used to behave well...\nbut lately it can turn violent suddenly.
I see, so it happened suddenly...\nWell, that's none of our business anyway...
Hey...Don't tell me you're gonna stick your nose\ninto this case?!
We don't have time for that you know!\nLet's go now...
...Hold on!\nIf you could do something about that giant crab,\nI'll reward you.
Well, well, let us hear your offer...\nBy the way, what could be causing the giant crab\nto turn violent?
...Umm...maybe something that provokes it...
Something that provokes it?
...Like showing some suspicious behavior in front\nof it...
...or acting weird...
...making such erratic moves...
...might have provoked it.\nBut who in the world did that...
Um...Somehow I feel like the provoker may not be\nvery far from us...
...What?! Where? Where is it?!
Ah, getting involved with it would be complicated,\nso just forget it...You want us to do something\nabout the giant crab, right?
...Yes. At first, I was going to send some of my\nskilled servants out...
Hey wait! She hasn't even told us how much she'd\nreward us, why did you agree so early? Let's make\nher pay us more...oops, I mean, negotiate...
...Umm...excuse me...
You think your reputation will fall if you get\npaid? Listen, it's not good if you keep agreeing\nto do something without thinking twice...!
...You two.\nGo and calm them down...
That's why!\nI told you to just leave stuff like this to me! We\nmust make as much money as possible when we could!
We always earn less than what we could actually\nmake because you're like this...!
Who's it?! So annoying!\nWe're in the middle of an important business talk,\ndon't you dare interrupt!
...He said that was an excellent hit since you hit\nhim exactly on the chin...
...He asked if you want to train to be a wizard\nwith him...
Sorry, I don't really get what you're talking\nabout...
...Usakichi, Usami.\nYou two may leave. Anyway...
...Once again, please.\nTake care of that giant crab.
...Thank you for fulfilling my request this time.
Well, surprisingly it was easy.
Anyway, you've prepared the reward, haven't you?
Oh!
...What's wrong?
B-b...behind you...
...There's nothing though.
Never mind.\nLet me just get my reward and get out of this\nplace quickly...
Shoooot?!
...What happened?
O-on the ceiling...
...I don't see anything though...
Hmpf~...Okay. I might have been seeing things.\nAll right, I'm a brave girl. I won't lose.
...All right, your reward...
Oh yeah! C'mon! Faster!\nGive it to us quickly♪
...Excuse me, is there...?
N-nothing.\nAnyway, we've worked quite hard for this.\nIf the reward is cheap...
...What's the matter?
N-not-nothing...It's just...\nWe'll be grateful for the reward, yeah.
...Thank you for your hard work this time.\nDo you have any requests?
Oh, umm...well, yes. Could you tell your\nservants to try not to go near the giant crab,\nplease?
...Fine.\nAll right then, here's your reward.
...Well, the full moon is about to end.\nI shall send you off.
...How was it? Was it too powerful?
I believe in you.\nI'll be waiting for good news from you.
How is the progress?\nYes, those moving dangos are quite tough...\nPlease collect as many as I requested.
Have you collected as many as I requested?\nThe dangos got big and turned into a monster...?\nOh, no. Sorry, but please get rid of it!
Uh-oh...Um? This is...
See, something I didn't want to happen actually\nhappened!
Thank you for coming...
T-there she is...
I've been waiting for the full moon night to come\nsince I want you to do me a favor as you were able\nto bring the giant crab under control before...
Wait, wait, wait!\nWhy does it have to be us again?
When you left last time, I remember you said that\nyou would help as long as I prepare some\nrewards...
D-did I say so?!\nI think I said I would help only if you could\ncome up with something more lucrative next time...
I remember saying that tho?\nI feel like you've misunderstood what I said...
Oh my gosh...\nO-o-okay, s-s-so what's the thing we need to do?
Thank you. Actually...
Uh...Tsukimi Dangos???
Ah-oh...what's going on here?!
...I don't know why, but recently the Tsukimi\nDangos I made have been growing legs and all of\nthem just ran away...
Eek...How did that happen tho...?
I want you to catch and collect the dangos that\nhave escaped...That's the favor I'd like to ask\nyou this time.
What do we do after we collect them?\nI don't think I can eat such disgusting dangos...
Y-you want us to collect and put the dangos here?\nO-o-okay, I got it...Well, since we'll get some\nrewards, we'll do it. Hey, let's go!
Thank you for collecting the dangos.\nI'll have Usakichi and Usami collect the giant\ndangos that you have taken care of.
Um, getting the rewards is nice, but...\nI feel like the rewards are just not worth my time\nand effort...
When I find myself in trouble again, I'll come to\nyou to ask for help.\nPlease lend me a hand then.
Eh?!
Alright, bye then...\nLet's see each other again on a full moon night!
